definitions.explanation: A visible mass of water vapor in the sky.

examples.english: There are clouds in the sky.

notes:
{雲|くも} means cloud.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- {雲|くも}: cloud
- {蜘蛛|くも}: spider

COMPOUNDS:
- {雨雲|あまぐも}: rain cloud
- {入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}: cumulonimbus
- {雲海|うんかい}: sea of clouds

EXPRESSIONS:
- {雲|くも}をつかむよう: vague, elusive
